text: dekh maine git cli install kiya fir bhi jab mai comment kiya claude kuch run hi nahi kar raha dekh aur bata
Screenshot dekh liya. Pehle main check karta hoon ki `gh` install aur login hai ya nahi.

Git/gh install sahi hai, problem wo nahi hai.

**Check ka result**
- `gh` 2.103.2 installed hai aur `sunil5151` account se login hai. Scopes `repo`, `workflow`, `read:org` hain, jo kaafi hain.
- `git` 2.49.0 bhi sahi hai.

**Asli problem screenshot mein hai**
- `claude setup-token` ek interactive command hai. Ye browser kholkar login maangta hai aur jawab ka wait karta hai.
- Mere shell mein koi browser ya keyboard input nahi hota, isliye ye 120 sec baad timeout hokar background mein chala gaya (`bm69kelzs`). Ye kabhi complete nahi hoga, isliye "kuch run nahi ho raha" lag raha hai.
- Neeche wala "Background work is running" menu bas ye pooch raha hai ki exit par is task ko kya karna hai.

**Ab kya karo**
1. Us menu mein **1. Exit and stop tasks** chuno aur Enter dabao, taaki atka hua task band ho jaye.
2. Apne normal terminal (PowerShell) mein ye chalao, mere through nahi:
   ```
   claude setup-token
   ```
   Browser khulega, login karo, aur terminal mein ek token print hoga (`sk-ant-oat...`). Use copy kar lo.
3. GitHub par repo kholo: Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret. Name `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` rakho aur value mein token paste karo.
   Ya terminal se: `gh secret set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. Ye token maangega, use paste kar do.
4. Workflow file (`.github/workflows/claude.yml`) ki zaroorat ho to bata dena, main bana dunga.

**Ek dhyan rakhne wali baat:** `gh` mein account `sunil5151` hai, jabki git user `sunilsonumonu12` hai. Agar repo dusre account ka hai to secret set karte waqt permission error aa sakta hai. Tab `gh auth switch` se sahi account chuno.

Token kisi file ya chat mein mat paste karna. Wo secret hai.
token shayad mis hogaya age dabate gaya aur yeh page agaya hai token nahi mila

Login ho gaya, bas token terminal mein print hua tha aur wo scroll ho gaya ya band terminal ke saath chala gaya. Token dobara nikal sakte ho, sirf `setup-token` phir se chalana hai.

**Dobara karo**
1. VS Code mein naya terminal kholo (Ctrl+`) ya alag PowerShell window lo. Claude Code wala terminal mat lo.
2. Ye chalao:
   ```
   claude setup-token
   ```
3. Browser mein dobara authorize karo. Ye page aaye to samajh lo ki login ho gaya.
4. Ab terminal par wapas aao aur **koi key mat dabao**. Wahan `sk-ant-oat01-...` jaisa lamba token print hoga. Ye aksar login ke baad ek-do second mein dikhta hai.
5. Token turant select karke copy kar lo. Agar line wrap ho gayi hai to poori line select karna, beech mein cut mat hone dena.

**Token ko seedha secret mein daalo (copy ki jhanjhat nahi):**
```
gh secret set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
```
Ye prompt maangega. Token paste karo (paste karte waqt screen par kuch nahi dikhta, ye normal hai) aur Enter dabao.

**Agar fir bhi token na dikhe**
- Naya terminal bada karo, ya `claude setup-token` ka output file mein bhej do:
  ```
  claude setup-token | Tee-Object token.txt
  ```
  Phir `token.txt` se token copy karo, secret set karne ke baad **us file ko turant delete kar do** aur kabhi commit mat karna.
- Purane token ko revoke karne ki zaroorat nahi hai, naya token bas naya bana dega.

Secret set hone ke baad `gh secret list` chalao. Usme `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` dikhna chahiye.

Workflow file ban gayi: [.github/workflows/claude.yml](.github/workflows/claude.yml). Wo `@claude` likhne par issue, PR ya comment mein trigger hogi.

**Abhi tak:** file sirf local hai. GitHub par tab chalegi jab ye default branch (`main`) par pahunchegi.

**Rukawat:** pehle ka `git push origin main` non-fast-forward se reject hua tha (origin par 7 naye commits). Abhi tum `push-fix` branch par ho. Push, commit ya merge main bina tumhari ijazat ke nahi karunga.

**Tumhare paas 2 raste hain:**
1. Is file ko akela commit karke `push-fix` push karo aur GitHub par PR se `main` mein merge karo. Ye sabse safe hai.
2. Pehle `main` ka rebase conflict suljhao, phir push karo.

Batao kaunsa chahiye. Pehla chuno to main sirf `claude.yml` ka commit banakar `push-fix` push karne se pehle tumse confirm kar lunga.
